about.title: Thoughtful outreach. Lasting relationships.
paragraphs: I'm Aneesa Tariq, a business development and client acquisition specialist based in Islamabad, Pakistan. My experience spans B2B lead generation, international client acquisition, freelance bidding, account management, and client communication.
I bring structure to the conversations around growth: researching prospects, tailoring proposals, following up with care, and keeping clients and delivery teams aligned on what comes next.

My focus is the business and relationship side of a project. When a scope calls for specialized technical implementation, I coordinate with the appropriate delivery specialists rather than presenting their work as my own technical expertise.
about.expertiseIntro: The relationship side of business growth.
